specs.Item Type Name: Rechargeble Bluetooth Wireless Keyboard with Wireless mouse

features: 【Multi Connectivity】The keyboard and mouse compatible with Tablet, Phone, Notebook and Desktops, Design is Ultraslim and Keyboard is having Anti Slip back Mat with 78 Keys

【Bluetooth Connection】The keyboard and mouse adopt advanced Bluetooth chip technology to provide stable and powerful cordless connection, it’s easy to connect and easy to use. The working range up to 10m. This keyboard features volume control, previous, next, and other media hot keys.

【Ultra Slim & Lightweight】The keyboard size is 33 x 17 x 4 CM, Weight is 261 gms. The thin, cute and light weight design, can be easily to put into a backpack or handbag and easy to carry anywhere, suitable for home school office or travel use. Perfect for typing emails, note taking, document. The mouse has 3 adjustable DPI levels (800/1200/1600), you can easily adjust the sensitivity of the mouse according to your needs.

【Rechargeable Battery】The keyboard and mouse both have built-in rechargeable lithium battery, continuous working time up to 150 hours after fully charged, no need to replace the batteries. They will go to automatic sleep mode in about 15 minutes if not use and you can press any button to wake it up again.
【Ultra Thin Mouse】Mouse is ultra thin and ultra quiet, ergonomically designed, feels comfortable, Three speed adjustable DPI 800‐1200‐1600, easy to deal with daily office and game moments.
